arxiv-2012-02180.title: Large- N c N_{c} and renormalization group constraints on parity-violating low-energy coefficients for three-derivative operators in pionless effective field theory
arxiv-2012-02180.creator: Son T. Nguyen, Matthias R. Schindler, Roxanne P. Springer, Jared Vanasse
arxiv-2012-02180.description: Abstract We extend from operators with one derivative to operators with three derivatives the analysis of two-body hadronic parity violation in a combined pionless effective field theory (EFT π / {}_{\pi\hskip-3.27773pt/} ) and large- N c N_{c} expansion, where N c N_{c} is the number of colors in quantum chromodynamics (QCD).

arxiv-2111-07747.title: Ribet’s conjecture for Eisenstein maximal ideals
arxiv-2111-07747.creator: Debargha Banerjee, Narasimha Kumar, Dipramit Majumdar
arxiv-2111-07747.description: Abstract . According to Ogg’s conjecture (Mazur’s Theorem), cuspidal subgroup coincides with rational torsion points of the Jacobian variety of modular curves of the form X 0 ​ ( N ) X_{0}(N) for a prime number N N . There is a recent interest to generalize the conjecture for arbitrary N N by Ribet, Ohta and Yoo.

arxiv-2209-04225.title: Generalised Hardy type and Rellich type inequalities on the Heisenberg group
arxiv-2209-04225.creator: Abimbola Abolarinwa, Michael Ruzhansky
arxiv-2209-04225.description: Abstract . This paper is primarily devoted to a class of interpolation inequalities of Hardy and Rellich types on the Heisenberg group ℍ n \mathbb{H}^{n} . Consequently, several weighted Hardy type, Heisenberg-Pauli-Weyl uncertainty principle and Hardy-Rellich type inqualities are established on ℍ n \mathbb{H}^{n} . Moreover, new weighted Sobolev type embeddings are derived.

arxiv-2303-14216.title: Two Finite Element Approaches For The Porous Medium Equation That Are Positivity Preserving And Energy Stable Thanks: This research is partially supported by NSF grant DMS-2012031.
arxiv-2303-14216.creator: Arjun Vijaywargiya, Guosheng Fu
arxiv-2303-14216.description: Abstract . In this work, we present the construction of two distinct finite element approaches to solve the Porous Medium Equation (PME). In the first approach, we transform the PME to a log-density variable formulation and construct a continuous Galerkin method.

arxiv-2307-02109.title: Aeroacoustic investigation of airfoil at near stall conditions
arxiv-2307-02109.creator: Prateek Jaiswal, Jose Rendón, Stéphane Moreau
arxiv-2307-02109.description: Abstract This paper presents a detailed aeroacoustic investigation of a Controlled-Diffusion airfoil at near stall condition. The study aims at answering two research questions: identify the flow mechanism responsible for separation noise for an airfoil near stall conditions and whether the noise is generated by a dipole for airfoil close to stall and can be quantified by Amiet’s diffraction theory.

arxiv-2311-14169.title: Evaluating GPT-4’s Vision Capabilities on Brazilian University Admission Exams
arxiv-2311-14169.creator: Ramon Pires, Thales Sales Almeida, Hugo Abonizio, and Rodrigo Nogueira
arxiv-2311-14169.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ramon Pires, Thales Sales Almeida, Hugo Abonizio, and Rodrigo Nogueira. Recent advancements in language models have showcased human-comparable performance in academic entrance exams. However, existing studies often overlook questions that require the integration of visual comprehension, thus compromising the full spectrum and complexity inherent in real-world scenarios. To address this gap, we present a comprehensive framework to evaluate language models on entrance exams, which incorporates both textual and visual elements.

arxiv-2409-06926.title: Minimum Viable Ethics: From Institutionalizing Industry AI Governance to Product Impact
arxiv-2409-06926.creator: Archana Ahlawat, Amy Winecoff, Jonathan Mayer
arxiv-2409-06926.description: Abstract . Across the technology industry, many companies have expressed their commitments to AI ethics and created dedicated roles responsible for translating high-level ethics principles into product. Yet it is unclear how effective this has been in leading to meaningful product changes.

pmc-10573007.title: Quadriceps Strength, Postural Stability, and Pain Mediation in Bilateral Knee Osteoarthritis: A Comparative Analysis with Healthy Controls
pmc-10573007.creator: Mastour Saeed Alshahrani, Ravi Shankar Reddy, Evangelos Terpos
pmc-10573007.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Bilateral knee osteoarthritis (OA) poses significant challenges to individuals’ functional abilities, including quadriceps strength, postural stability, and pain perception. Understanding the complex relationships among these factors is crucial for enhancing knee OA management strategies. The primary objective of this research is to evaluate and draw comparisons between the strength of the quadriceps and the level of postural stability in two distinct groups: individuals afflicted with bilateral knee OA and those who are healthy.

pmc-11433504.title: Recycling of Polyurethane Foams via Glycolysis: A Review
pmc-11433504.creator: Kinga Wieczorek, Przemysław Bukowski, Krystian Stawiński, Iwona Ryłko
pmc-11433504.description: Polyurethane foams constitute highly problematic waste due to their low density and consequently large volume. Among the most promising recycling approaches, the glycolysis of polyurethane waste stands out and was extensively discussed in this article. Existing literature reviews lack a detailed analysis of glycolysis processes and a clear presentation of the most important data.

pmc-11515666.title: Nursing and midwifery simulation training with a newly developed low-cost high-fidelity placenta simulator: a collaboration between Italy and Ethiopia
pmc-11515666.creator: Amerigo Ferrari, Sabina Maglio, Selamawit Tamirat, Moges Tesfaye, Melaku Wolde, Fabio Manenti, Enzo Facci, Ilaria Corazza, Selene Tognarelli, Milena Vainieri, Arianna Menciassi
pmc-11515666.description: BackgroundSimulation training provides safe environment for skill acquisition and retention. This study addresses a critical challenge in Africa – umbilical cord and placenta management after childbirth – aiming to bridge theoretical learning with practical experiences through simulation. We realized a new low-cost high-fidelity simulator of placenta and umbilical cord.

pmc-11646403.title: Low Plasma Levels of Contactin-Associated Protein-Like 2 in Children with Autism Spectrum Disorder: Links to Neural Development
pmc-11646403.creator: Laila Yosif Alayadhi, Dost Muhammad Halepoto, Abdulrahman Mohammed Alhowikan, Nadra Elyass Elamin, Aurangzeb Taj Halepota
pmc-11646403.description: BackgroundAutism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a condition of atypical neurodevelopment and is characterized by social communication problems and repetitive patterns of behavior. Early diagnosis and intervention are decisive for managing symptoms and improving outcomes. Contactin-associated protein-like 2 (CNTNAP2) protein is implicated in neural development and plays a role in brain connectivity and synapse formation.

pmc-12554136.title: Association between exposure to tobacco control measures and current nicotine use among adolescents in Saudi Arabia: Evidence from the 2022 global youth tobacco survey
pmc-12554136.creator: Najim Z Alshahrani
pmc-12554136.description: ObjectivesThe World Health Organization's six tobacco control strategies (Monitor, Protect, Offer help, Warn, Enforce, and Raise; MPOWER) aim to reduce tobacco use, yet little is known about their impact on individual-level adolescent nicotine use in Middle Eastern countries. This study examined whether exposure to MPOWER policies is associated with current nicotine use among adolescents in Saudi Arabia.

pmc-12567800.title: Precautionary Health Behaviours as Potential Confounders in COVID-19 Vaccine Effectiveness Studies
pmc-12567800.creator: Chloé Wyndham-Thomas, Leonie de Munter, Kok Yew Ngew, Sanskruti Gaikwad, Konstantina Chatzikonstantinidou, Antonio Carmona, Charlotte Martin, Gerrit Luit ten Kate, Nicolas Praet, Wilhelmine Meeraus, Matthew D Rousculp, Kaatje Bollaerts, Gianluca Voglino, Giuseppina Lo Moro, Maria Rosaria Gualano, Er
pmc-12567800.description: Background/Objectives: Precautionary health behaviours (PHBs), such as hand-washing or self-isolation, are non-pharmaceutical interventions used to reduce SARS-CoV-2 transmission. We investigated the potential confounding by PHBs of COVID-19 vaccine effectiveness (VE) estimates in a subset of study participants enrolled in id.DRIVE. Methods: The id.

pmc-12651044.title: Foetal Growth Restriction Effects on Grey and White Matter in the Prefrontal Cortex and Basal Ganglia of Postnatal Day 10 Piglets
pmc-12651044.creator: Bhuvaneswari Harishankar, Kirat K Chand, Paul B Colditz, Julie A Wixey, Giovanni Levi
pmc-12651044.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Foetal growth restriction (FGR) is commonly caused by placental insufficiency and increases the risk of perinatal morbidity and mortality. The developing brain is vulnerable to FGR, which can result in adverse long-term neurodevelopmental outcomes. Newborn pigs with spontaneous FGR (<10th centile body weight) and normally grown (NG) littermates were reared to postnatal day 10 (P10; n = 8 FGR and n = 9 NG).

pmc-12999782.title: Case Report: Pediatric chylous ascites beyond congenital malformations—infectious causes and nutritional management with a literature review
pmc-12999782.creator: Teresa Capriati, Annalisa Carciofi, Chiara Grimaldi, Andrzej Krzysztofiak, Simona Gatti, Maria Elena Lionetti, Michela Caprarelli, Annalisa Morelli, Lucia Tulli, Antonella Diamanti
pmc-12999782.description: Chylous ascites (CA) is a condition characterized by the accumulation of lymphatic fluid in the peritoneal cavity. Although congenital malformations are the most common cause in newborns, infectious agents represent a clinically significant, potentially reversible etiology that benefits from specific therapy.

pmc-13234170.title: Akkermansia muciniphila drives viscero-visceral crosstalk via 5-HT3aR-mediated sensitization of dichotomizing gut–bladder neurons
pmc-13234170.creator: Qi Sun, Yubo Gao, Jun Zheng, Rulin Liao, Haotian Jiang, Zhangrui Zhu, Ming Xie, Yao Yu, Yuexuan Zhu, Weijia Li, Wentai Shangguan, Leqian Li, Xinhang Shi, Qishen Yang, Jiao Zeng, Zongwei Wang, Jie Zhao, Bisheng Cheng, Peng Wu
pmc-13234170.description: The comorbidity of overactive bladder (OAB) and irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) presents a major clinical challenge, with the underlying neural and microbial mechanisms of the gut–bladder axis poorly understood. Here we aimed to delineate the complete causal pathway from a specific gut microorganism to bladder dysfunction and validate it as a therapeutic target.
